crossRefs.note: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any…
